question: The figure a rig operator wants, in kN, is the combined mount load of 3 identical rigs, each rig's mount load expressed in kN. A rig's mount load is the drive force on its sled, minus 4 kN supplied by a booster spring, plus 14 kN of static preload. Each sled has a mass of 82000 grams, and its velocity in m/s after t seconds is v(t) = 5t^3 + 0t^2. The drive force is the force producing the sled's acceleration at t = 2 s. What combined mount load, in kN, does the operator report?

The number a foundry wants, in N, is the grand total over 12 identical shifts, each shift's total being the frame load of a casting line. The frame load is the combined push of 12 identical stations, each station driving 4 identical moulds, plus 18 N from a guide spring. Each mould has a mass of 178000 grams and is pushed with the force producing its acceleration. That acceleration in m/s^2 is the sum of the squares of the whole numbers from 1 to 4. What grand total, in N, does the foundry report?

The figure a courier network wants, in J, is the grand total energy of motion across 10 identical regions, each region having 7 identical depots, each depot running 10 identical routes, each route using 7 identical vans, every van carrying the same energy of motion. Each van is a scale test model of mass 20 kg and length 0.8 m. The vans' speed in m/s equals the speed at t = 2 s of a pace vehicle whose position in metres is s(t) = 2t^3 + 2t^2 with t in seconds. What grand total, in J, does the network report?

The figure a lab wants, in kJ, is the total energy on a test bench: the combined energy of motion of 8 identical trolleys, plus 17 J from a heater coil, plus 22 J from a charging capacitor. Each trolley has a mass of 18000 grams. The trolleys' speed in m/s is the largest whole number that divides both 88 and 163 exactly. What total energy, in kJ, does the lab record?

A car-plant conveyor accelerates body shells of mass 105000 grams along a line. Each shell's acceleration in m/s^2 is the largest whole number that divides both 256 and 159 exactly, and the force producing it is expressed in kN. A line carries 10 identical shells, a hall has 2 identical lines, and the plant has 6 identical halls. What total force, in kN, is applied to all the shells?

A rescue drone of mass 56000 grams cruises at a speed in m/s equal to 9 times the sum of 3 and 5. A patrol is 7 identical drones flying at that speed, and the ground station adds 3 J for the energy in its telemetry capacitor to the patrol's combined energy of motion. Express the resulting patrol total in kJ.

A robotic pallet mover of mass 36000 grams runs on a warehouse rail 28 m long, and its velocity in m/s after t seconds is v(t) = 3t^3 + 3t^2. The force producing its acceleration at t = 2 s is expressed in kN. A bay drives 5 identical movers, and each bay's frame also carries 2 kN of static load on top of the combined drive. The warehouse has 12 identical bays. What total load, in kN, do the 12 bay frames carry?

The figure a conveyor installer wants, in kN, is the net cable load: the combined load of 11 identical hoists minus 20 N of relief from a balance spring. Each hoist's load is the force producing its carriage's acceleration plus 20 N of guide friction. Each carriage has a mass of 108 kg and runs on a level rail 30 m long. The carriages' acceleration in m/s^2 is the largest whole number that divides both 216 and 181 exactly. What net cable load, in kN, does the installer record?

The number a drone-range manager wants, in kJ, is the daily total: 12 identical sessions, each session's figure being the combined energy of motion of 3 identical drones, expressed in kJ, minus 3 kJ consumed by the launch catapult. Each drone has a mass of 8 kg. The drones' speed in m/s is set equal to the acceleration at t = 1 s of a chase car whose position in metres is s(t) = 5t^3 + 6t^2 with t in seconds. What daily total, in kJ, does the manager record?

A ski-resort test sled of mass 15000 grams runs down a slope 200 m long at a speed in m/s equal to the area under the curve y = 3x^2 + 2x between x = 3 and x = 4. Its energy of motion is expressed in kJ, and 20 kJ of stored winch energy is added to give one run's figure. A pair of identical runs has 2 times that figure, from which 7 kJ absorbed by the run-out mats is subtracted. What net figure, in kJ, does the resort record for the pair?

The figure a port engineer wants, in kN, is the total load on a gantry: 13 kN of static rigging plus the combined drive force of 5 identical cranes, each crane's drive force expressed in kN. Each crane drives 11 identical trolleys, and each trolley has a mass of 163 kg and a wheelbase of 1.8 m. The trolleys' acceleration in m/s^2 is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 8x + 12 = 0, and each trolley is driven with the force producing that acceleration. What total gantry load, in kN, does the engineer report?

The number a depot wants, in kN, is the combined pusher load for 5 identical carts. Each cart's pusher load is the force producing its acceleration, minus 27 N supplied by a ramp, plus 22 N of wheel friction. Each cart has a mass of 162000 grams. The carts' acceleration in m/s^2 is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 4x + 3 = 0. What combined pusher load, in kN, does the depot record?

A lab bench drives a slider of mass 31 kg along a rail 1.6 m long. The slider's acceleration in m/s^2 is 2 times the largest whole number that divides both 21 and 199 exactly. The force producing that acceleration is supplied partly by a spring, which contributes 18 N, and the motor supplies the rest. Seven identical sliders run on identical rails, and a counterweight relieves 6 N of the 7 motors' combined output. What net output, in N, do the motors supply?

The number a shipyard wants, in N, is the total load on a launch frame: 12 N from a guide spring plus the combined thrust of 5 identical bays, each bay driving 5 identical sleds, every sled receiving the same thrust. Each sled has a mass of 179000 grams. The sleds' acceleration in m/s^2 is 10 times the largest whole number that divides both 74 and 92 exactly, and each thrust is the force producing that acceleration. What total frame load, in N, does the shipyard report?

A rocket sled of mass 174000 grams is accelerated along a rail at an acceleration in m/s^2 equal to 3 times the sum of 7 and 17. The force producing that acceleration is expressed in kN; the rail brake applies 15 kN in the opposite direction, and the difference, taking the drive direction as positive, is the net force per sled. Four identical sleds run at once, and a headwind adds a further 6 kN against the direction of travel to the combined net force of the 4 sleds. What is the resulting combined net force, in kN?

The figure a launch crew wants, in N, is the total load on a sled's tow fitting: the drive force, minus 27 N supplied by a booster spring, plus 4 N of rail friction, plus 9 N of cable drag, plus 15 N from an instrumentation tether. The sled has a mass of 163000 grams. Its acceleration in m/s^2 equals the area under the curve y = 3x^2 + 7x between x = 0 and x = 3, and the drive force is the force producing that acceleration. What total fitting load, in N, does the crew record?

A bakery conveyor accelerates trays of mass 31 kg along a belt 9 m long. Each tray's acceleration in m/s^2 is the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 12x + 35 = 0, and each tray is driven with the force producing that acceleration. A lane carries 2 identical trays, and the conveyor runs 4 identical lanes. Express the total drive force in kN.

A bottling plant moves crates of mass 24000 grams at a speed in m/s equal to the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 9x + 8 = 0. A pallet holds 11 identical crates, a bay holds 2 identical pallets, and the plant has 12 identical bays. Express the total energy of motion of all the crates in kJ.

The figure a marina wants, in kN, is the net winch load: the combined motor force of 7 identical winches, expressed in kN, minus 3 kN of relief from a counterweight. Each winch drags a boat cradle of mass 90 kg along a level slipway; the force producing the cradle's acceleration is supplied partly by a helper spring, which contributes 18 N, and the winch motor supplies the rest. The cradles' acceleration in m/s^2 equals the area under the curve y = 3x^2 + 4x between x = 2 and x = 3. What net winch load, in kN, does the marina report?

A rescue drone of mass 55000 grams cruises at a speed in m/s equal to 3 times the sum of 2 and 15. Its energy of motion is expressed in kJ, and 2 kJ of reserve battery energy is added to give one drone's energy figure. A patrol is 9 identical drones. What is the patrol's total energy figure, in kJ?

The number a plant manager wants, in N, is the combined motor output for 12 identical carts. Each cart's motor output is the force producing its acceleration minus 24 N supplied by a helper spring. Each cart has a mass of 37000 grams and a bed 1.1 m long. The carts' acceleration in m/s^2 is 1 less than the area under the curve y = 2x^2 + 6x between x = 1 and x = 3. What combined motor output, in N, does the manager record?

A sorting centre accelerates totes of mass 75000 grams along chutes 7 m long. Each tote's acceleration in m/s^2 is 3 times the sum of 2 and 11, and each tote is driven with the force producing that acceleration. A chute drives 12 identical totes, and the combined force per chute is expressed in kN. A hall has 3 identical chutes, and the centre has 10 identical halls. What total force, in kN, is applied to all the totes?

The figure a lab wants, in kN, is the net drive on a bench: the combined push on 4 identical carts minus 29 N supplied by a helper spring. Each cart has a mass of 23 kg, and the push on each is the force producing its acceleration. The carts' acceleration in m/s^2 is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 6x + 5 = 0. What net drive, in kN, does the lab record?

A luggage cart of mass 107 kg is accelerated along an apron 55 m wide. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is found by taking the area under the curve y = 2x^2 + 0x between x = 0 and x = 3, subtracting 15, and multiplying by 8. The force producing that acceleration is supplied partly by a tailwind, which contributes 9 N, and the tug supplies the rest. What force, in N, does the tug supply?

A 15000 gram sled runs along a rail 6 m long at a speed in m/s equal to the area under the curve y = 2x^2 + 0x between x = 2 and x = 4. A logger takes the sled's energy of motion, subtracts 10 J lost to rail friction, adds 13 J from the brake spring, and adds 6 J from a charging coil. What final energy, in J, does the logger record?
